text.content: If you use Microsoft OneNote long enough, you know the feeling. It starts organized. One notebook, a few sections, everything neatly named. Then life happens. You start a new project — new section. You save a password somewhere — new page. You take a meeting note — wherever. Three years later, you have 200+ pages scattered across dozens of sections, with no consistent structure, no naming convention, and a vague anxiety every time you open the app.

text.content: MCP is an open standard created by Anthropic that lets AI assistants like Claude connect to external tools and services — not through a web browser, but through a direct, structured interface. Think of it like a universal plug: you build an MCP server for your app or service, and any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed, Continue.dev) can use it immediately.
